title: Let complaint leave the mouth
summary: This meets the mind that has grown used to crying out, muttering, and protesting. The line says service ripens into a quieter heart where complaint no longer rules the tongue.
takeaway: Serve until complaint loses its grip.
lifeApplication: When the sigh, mutter, or repeated grievance starts rising, pause with lips closed and shoulders dropped. Do one act of service before telling the story again.

source.shortMeaning: Service softens the mind until complaint no longer leads.
source.lifeApplication: When protest rises, serve first and let the mouth grow quieter.

evidence.coreClaim: Service softens the mind until complaint no longer leads.
evidence.turn: Serve the Guru until complaint thins and love for the Beloved rises.
